CheckTitle: IAM role used by an AWS service does not have AdministratorAccess attached
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Description: Custom check (Identity & Cloud Posture Health Check). **IAM roles that AWS services assume** (Lambda, EC2 and others; not AWS service-linked roles) are evaluated for attachment of the AWS-managed `AdministratorAccess` policy. Prowler's own `iam_role_administratoraccess_policy` excludes these roles.
Risk: Code running as the service (a Lambda function, a server) can do anything in the account. A flaw in that code, or stolen temporary credentials, gives full control.

Code.Other: IAM > Roles > the role > Permissions: remove AdministratorAccess and attach a policy with only the actions the service needs.

Recommendation.Text: Give each service role only the actions its code needs.

Notes: Custom check shipped with this tool in prowler-checks/; mounted read-only into the Prowler container.
